name: Exp_FrAMACandle
summary: This EA trades based on the FrAMACandle custom indicator, which combines Fractal Adaptive Moving Average (FRAMA) logic to detect trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options. Entry and exit are controlled by boolean flags for each direction, and trade execution only occurs on new bars to avoid repeated signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于FrAMACandle自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了分形自适应移动平均线(FRAMA)逻辑来检测趋势方向。当指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。买卖双向的入场和出场均可通过布尔开关独立控制，交易执行仅在出现新K线时触发以避免重复信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于FrAMACandle自定义指标的分形自适应移动平均线(FRAMA)趋势判断，利用指标的缓冲区4（TrendValue）读取趋势状态值0、1、2来决定交易方向。入场条件为：当TrendValue从非2变为2时触发买入信号（需BuyPosOpen开启），当TrendValue从非0变为0时触发卖出信号（需SellPosOpen开启），趋势转变即入场。出场条件为：当趋势从上升转为其他状态时平多仓（需BuyPosClose开启），当趋势从下降转为其他状态时平空仓（需SellPosClose开启），同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制交易手数或资金比例，支持五种模式包括固定手数、按余额百分比、按净值百分比等。资金管理使用枚举类型MarginMode选择不同的计算方式，默认为固定手数模式(LOT)，整体风险控制依赖固定止损止盈而非动态调整。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Fractal Adaptive Moving Average (FRAMA) implemented via the FrAMACandle custom indicator, which adapts its smoothing speed based on market fractal dimension to better follow trends. Entry conditions are triggered when the indicator's buffer 4 (TrendValue) transitions to 2 for buy signals (if BuyPosOpen is enabled) or transitions to 0 for sell signals (if SellPosOpen is enabled), requiring a change from a different state to confirm trend initiation. Exit conditions close long positions when the uptrend signal disappears (BuyPosClose enabled) and close short positions when the downtrend signal disappears (SellPosClose enabled), supplemented by fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with five money management modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance, and loss-adjusted free margin. Money management defaults to the LOT (fixed lot) mode and overall risk control relies on static stop-loss and take-profit values rather than dynamic adaptation to market volatility or ATR-based calculations.

parameters.description: 交易手数或资金管理比例
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter, controls lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode: Free margin/Balance/Loss margin/Loss balance/Fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow buy to close (close long beyond SL/TP)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow sell to close (close short beyond SL/TP)

pros: 使用分形自适应移动平均线(FRAMA)，能根据市场波动性自动调节灵敏度，在趋势行情中表现优于普通均线
买卖方向和开平仓均可独立控制，灵活性高，适合不同市场观点的交易者
使用新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
pros_en: Uses Fractal Adaptive Moving Average (FRAMA) which automatically adjusts sensitivity based on market fractal dimension, outperforming simple moving averages in trending markets
Buy/sell direction and open/close operations can be independently controlled via boolean switches, offering high flexibility for traders with different market views
Implements new bar detection to prevent repeated signal execution within the same bar, reducing the risk of over-trading
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率(ATR)动态调整，在不同波动环境下可能不适配
依赖外部自定义指标FrAMACandle，若指标文件缺失或版本不匹配将导致初始化失败且无法交易
缺乏对持仓数量的检查和限制，可能在强趋势中连续加仓导致风险敞口过大
cons_en: Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed point values without ATR-based dynamic adjustment, which may be inappropriate across different volatility environments
Depends on an external custom indicator FrAMACandle; if the indicator file is missing or version-mismatched, initialization fails and trading is impossible
Lacks position count checks or limits, potentially leading to excessive position accumulation during strong trends and oversized risk exposure
improvements: 将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，使其能自适应不同市场波动环境
增加最大持仓数量限制和单方向最大仓位控制，防止过度集中风险
improvements_en: Replace fixed stop-loss/take-profit with ATR-based dynamic calculation for better adaptation to varying market volatility
Add maximum position count limits and per-direction position caps to prevent excessive concentration risk

risk_points: 固定止损1000点和止盈2000点在不同品种和波动环境下可能不合适，止损可能过大或过小
没有持仓数量限制，趋势持续时可能反复开仓导致累积风险敞口过大
依赖外部指标文件，存在运行时缺失导致策略完全失效的风险
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit may be inappropriate for different instruments and volatility regimes, potentially too wide or too narrow
No position count limits; sustained trends could trigger repeated entries leading to cumulatively oversized risk exposure
Dependency on external indicator file creates a single point of failure where strategy becomes completely inoperable if the file is missing
